# ai

> Model-pinned ZCode and Codex harness kits plus cross-harness skill
> categories. No installer, no build step, no dependencies: an AI agent
> pointed at this repo installs it by following the procedures below.

Layout: harness-specific kits under `harness/` (`zcode/`, `codex/`);
every other top-level directory (`copy/`, …) is a cross-harness skill
category that applies to every harness. To install, follow
[install.md](install.md) (ZCode kit + categories) or
[harness/codex/install.md](harness/codex/install.md) (Codex kit +
categories) — plain copies into `~/.zcode/agents/`, `~/.agents/skills/`,
and `~/.codex/`. Agent definitions must be regular files — ZCode's
discovery silently skips symlinks; `find ~/.zcode/agents -type l`
printing nothing confirms none.

## ZCode kit (`harness/zcode/`)

- [harness/zcode/agents/general-flash.md](harness/zcode/agents/general-flash.md): full-tools general agent pinned to glm-5.3-flash — objectively checkable work (CRUD, boilerplate, mechanical verification).
- [harness/zcode/agents/explore-flash.md](harness/zcode/agents/explore-flash.md): read-only search + code-audit agent pinned to glm-5.3-flash — reports findings, no verdict authority.
- [harness/zcode/agents/general-pro.md](harness/zcode/agents/general-pro.md): full-tools judgment agent pinned to glm-5.3 — complex implementation, audit verdicts, continue/stop decisions.
- [harness/zcode/skills/z-workflow/SKILL.md](harness/zcode/skills/z-workflow/SKILL.md): thin chain coordinator over zflow-engine — pro implement and judge runs with a flash run-level vision node chained between rounds, looping per POLICY until clean or honestly stopped.
- [harness/zcode/skills/z-proflow/SKILL.md](harness/zcode/skills/z-proflow/SKILL.md): the all-pro depth-first chain — every run pinned to the pro tier via subagent_model, no router, no pixel vision (pro is image-blind; ocu AX-text structural audits allowed).
- [harness/zcode/skills/z-flashflow/SKILL.md](harness/zcode/skills/z-flashflow/SKILL.md): the all-flash chain — every run pinned to flash; gates, fresh blind judges, fix rounds, and code-enforced POLICY exits compensate; hands off to z-proflow when a complex area stalls.
- [harness/zcode/skills/z-liteflow/SKILL.md](harness/zcode/skills/z-liteflow/SKILL.md): lightweight chain for small single-domain tasks — flash implement and judge runs looping between runs per finding, optional flash vision node.
- [harness/zcode/skills/z-gpui-workflow/SKILL.md](harness/zcode/skills/z-gpui-workflow/SKILL.md): fine-grained GPUI desktop chain — pro implement/judge runs, flash vision node for pixel design audits via ocu capture; main-thread computer-use plugin as interactive fallback only.
- [harness/zcode/workflows/zflow-engine.dwf.ts](harness/zcode/workflows/zflow-engine.dwf.ts): the ONE saved dynamic workflow all five z-flow skills chain over (implement / vision / judge nodes; world.run gate allowlist; Committer-drafted commits; POLICY as loop conditions in code). Installs as a saved workflow at ~/.zcode/workflows/ — harness/zcode/workflows/ is the source copy. Contract: [harness/zcode/workflows/zflow-SPEC.md](harness/zcode/workflows/zflow-SPEC.md).

## Cross-harness skill categories

Every top-level directory except `harness/` is a category holding
plain-SKILL.md skills (no harness tooling). All of them install for
every harness.

- [copy/antislop-copy/SKILL.md](copy/antislop-copy/SKILL.md): cuts consumer-facing website copy to the shortest version that still answers the visitor's questions, without inventing or bending facts.

## Codex kit (`harness/codex/`)

Installs the Z.ai Responses provider, five custom agents, six profiles,
a two-model catalog, and four skills while preserving the normal OpenAI
default. The `ZAI_API_KEY` import goes into the private Codex-only
`~/.codex/secrets/zai-api-key` file with mode `0600`; provider
authentication reads that file, and the key never enters Git or
`~/.codex/config.toml`. Full procedure:
[harness/codex/install.md](harness/codex/install.md).

- [harness/codex/agents](harness/codex/agents): `zai_flash`, `zai_vision`, `zai_pro`, and `zai_reviewer` at max reasoning, plus a low-effort read-only explorer.
- [harness/codex/plugins/zai-workflows](harness/codex/plugins/zai-workflows): publishable Codex plugin containing z-workflow, z-proflow, z-flashflow, and z-liteflow.

## Optional

- [README.md](README.md): full documentation — layout, categories, install paths, how to add skills/kits/harnesses.
- [install.md](install.md): the ZCode-kit + categories install procedure an AI agent executes.
- [.zcode-plugin/plugin.json](.zcode-plugin/plugin.json): install as a ZCode plugin (Settings → Plugin Management → Discover → + → this Git URL).
- [.claude-plugin/marketplace.json](.claude-plugin/marketplace.json): Claude Code marketplace manifest; also makes skills.sh discovery deterministic.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): orientation for AI agents working IN this repository (layout, conventions, extension rules).
